<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex021032025-12-0316-48-00" status="unreviewed"><lb n="40b1"/> de la mtshan nyid pa ni mthun par snang | don byed nus | rkyen las skyes | brtags pas dbyen pa dang bzhi rtso bo ste | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">bod ston</rs> gyis brtsis pa de ltar mi btub ste | 'gro ba so so la mthun snang ma grub pa'i phyir dang | don dam <lb n="40b2"/> shes pa'i shes pa dang | rigs pas brtags pas dbyen pa de khyed rang 'dod pa'i don dam du song ba yin gyi | kun rdzob men pas mtshan nyid bzhi tshang du mi btub || 
       tshang du btub kyang des lam du 'gro ba la mi phan pas na dgos pa <lb n="40b3"/> med do || </seg></TEI>
